description.value: You can read a settlement's real state of desperation off how its ration line is run, no questions asked. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Recall Knowledge checks about a settlement's current supply situation or internal unrest just by observing it for ten minutes.

cinderfall.incomplete: The +2 Recall Knowledge bonus is scoped to 'a settlement's current supply situation or internal unrest' -- the same topic-has-no-roll-option problem as Faction Ledger.
